_help: Video games and games in general (personality/knowledge.py).

entries.a: Tetris was created by Alexey Pajitnov, a Soviet engineer, in 1984.
Pac-Man is the arcade classic by Namco, released in 1980, where you eat dots and avoid four ghosts.
Mario was created by Shigeru Miyamoto at Nintendo, first appearing in Donkey Kong in 1981.
Luigi is Mario's younger twin brother.
Minecraft was made by Markus Persson, known as Notch, and released in full in 2011. Mojang and later Microsoft took it over.
Minecraft is the best selling video game of all time, with over three hundred million copies sold.
Fortnite was made by Epic Games. It came out in 2017.
Pokémon started in 1996 in Japan from Game Freak. The original games had 151 Pokémon.
Doom was made by id Software in 1993, and it pretty much invented the modern first person shooter.
Skyrim is the 2011 open world role playing game from Bethesda. It has been released on almost everything that has a screen.
No Man's Sky is by Hello Games, released in 2016, and updated massively since.
Half-Life is the 1998 shooter by Valve. Its hero is Gordon Freeman.
The Legend of Zelda is Nintendo's adventure series. You play Link, and Zelda is the princess.
Tennis for Two in 1958 is often called the first video game, and Pong in 1972 was the first big commercial hit.
Pong was made by Atari in 1972. It's a simple game of table tennis.
Space Invaders is a 1978 arcade game by Taito, and it was a worldwide hit.
The PlayStation is made by Sony, first released in 1994 in Japan.
The Xbox is made by Microsoft, first released in 2001.
The Nintendo Switch came out in 2017. It works as a home console and a handheld.
Steam is Valve's online store and game library for PC, launched in 2003.
Sonic the Hedgehog is Sega's fast blue mascot, first appearing in 1991.
Frontier Developments makes Elite Dangerous.
Star Citizen is a huge, long in development space game from Cloud Imperium Games.
EVE Online is an MMO space game famous for its player run economy and enormous battles.
RPG means role playing game, where you play a character who grows stronger as the story goes on.
MMO means massively multiplayer online, a game world shared by thousands of players.
A first person shooter is a game where you see through your character's eyes and shoot things.
A roguelike is a game with random levels where, if you die, you start again.
Speedrunning means finishing a game as fast as possible, often using glitches and weeks of practice.
To nerf something in a game is to make it weaker. To buff it is to make it stronger.
GG means good game, said at the end of a match.
AFK means away from keyboard.
An NPC is a non player character, a character controlled by the game and not a person.
DLC means downloadable content, extra game content you get after release.
Ping is how long a message takes to reach the game server and back, in milliseconds. High ping causes lag.
Esports is organised competitive video gaming, with professional players, teams and big prizes.
A chess set has thirty two pieces, sixteen for each player.
A chessboard has sixty four squares.
The queen is the most powerful piece in chess.
A standard deck has fifty two cards, plus jokers if you keep them.
A Rubik's Cube has about 43 quintillion possible positions.
Monopoly's design goes back to Elizabeth Magie's The Landlord's Game in 1904. The version we know was sold by Parker Brothers in 1935.
Dungeons and Dragons is the classic tabletop role playing game, first published in 1974, played with dice and imagination.
A normal die has six sides. Tabletop games also use four, eight, ten, twelve and twenty sided dice.
